name: termio
description: SSH terminal for slow and distant links

scripts.check:perf: cargo test --release -p termio-core flood -- --nocapture && cargo test --release -p termio-agent --test agent flood -- --nocapture && bun scripts/terminal-check.tsx
scripts.check: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && tsc --noEmit && bun test && bun run check:perf
scripts.build: cargo build --release -p termio-core && tarve build app/main.tsx --outfile dist/Termio.exe

tarve.name: Termio
tarve.description: SSH terminal for slow and distant links
